# Depth Player

> Depth Player is a free AI 2D to 3D VR video player for Meta Quest headsets (Quest 3, Quest 3S, Quest Pro, Quest 2) that converts 2D video to stereoscopic 3D in real time on the headset and smooths motion with frame interpolation. No PC, cloud or streaming software is required. Publisher: Halpindev.

## Key facts
- Category: VR video player / 2D-to-3D converter for Meta Horizon OS.
- 2D to 3D: an on-device AI monocular depth model (ZipDepth, 512x288) estimates per-frame depth on the Quest GPU; the app renders a separate view per eye (depth-image-based rendering) with occlusion handling and temporal stabilisation.
- 60 fps and higher: motion-compensated frame interpolation (motion smoothing) converts 24/30 fps video to 60, 72, 90 or 120 fps, with scene-cut and fast-motion artifact protection.
- Virtual cinema: flat or curved screen, adjustable size (up to 12 m wide) and distance (up to 10 m), grab-to-move, recenter.
- Upscaling: AMD FidelityFX Super Resolution 1 (FSR) or Snapdragon GSR for video below 1080p.
- Sources: local files (MP4, MKV, MOV, WebM and other formats via libVLC); DLNA/UPnP media servers (Plex, Jellyfin, Emby, NAS); SMB, SFTP, FTP, NFS shares; HTTP/HLS/RTSP stream links; built-in web browser with "Watch in VR", including YouTube on the VR screen.
- Player features: subtitles and audio track selection, aspect ratio and crop, resume playback, go-to-time, VR mode and 2D window mode.
- Languages: English, Russian, Spanish, German, French.
- Price: free; no ads, no accounts, no analytics. All video processing stays on the device.
- Limitations: copy-protected (DRM) streaming services such as Netflix or Prime Video cannot be converted to 3D.

## Compared with other tools
- SVP (Smooth Video Project) does frame interpolation and Owl3D does 2D-to-3D conversion, but both run on a PC. Depth Player does both in real time on the Meta Quest itself.
- Other Quest video players (Skybox, Moon VR Player, HereSphere) play existing 3D/VR video; Depth Player additionally converts ordinary 2D video to 3D live.
